1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.



About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



At 1Password, our purpose is to build a safe, simpler digital future for everyone. As a Senior Staff Performance Marketing Manager, you’ll lead multi-channel paid Business-to-Business (B2B) strategy that supports our sales-led growth motion, helping reach enterprise and mid-market audiences and turn marketing investment into qualified pipeline and revenue. Reporting to the Director of Performance Marketing, this role is open to candidates based in the United States or Canada.



How we’re using AI today
On the Marketing team, we’re growing our AI capability together and redesigning how work gets done. We’ve built agents to improve workflows focused on competitive intelligence, content creation, and campaign planning, helping us stay sharp, reduce context-switching, and surface the right information at the right time. AI helps us coordinate, execute, and uncover insights faster so we can spend more time on what’s most important: performance, judgement, and driving the future of 1Password.



This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.



What we're looking for:

• 8+ years of experience in performance marketing, demand generation, or growth marketing.

• Hands-on experience managing paid channels such as affiliates, paid social, display, native, programmatic, direct buys, or emerging channels.

• Experience supporting a sales-led growth motion and connecting marketing activity to Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs), Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs), pipeline, and revenue.

• A track record of driving measurable pipeline and revenue impact through paid B2B programs.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to make thoughtful decisions using incomplete or imperfect data.

• Experience partnering with campaign, analytics, marketing operations, or other cross-functional teams to improve performance.

• Experience marketing complex technical products to audiences such as developers, information technology (IT) professionals, or other technical decision-makers. Experience in cybersecurity or familiarity with artificial intelligence (AI) tools and automated workflows is also a plus.



What you can expect:

• Own the B2B performance marketing and demand generation strategy for a sales-led growth motion, aligning paid programs with pipeline and revenue objectives.

• Develop annual and quarterly roadmaps informed by business goals, audience insights, performance trends, and experimentation results.

• Manage paid channels and platforms end to end, from strategy and execution through optimization, reporting, and continuous improvement.

• Evaluate Return on Investment (ROI), marginal returns, and channel performance to guide budget shifts, scaling decisions, and investment strategy.

• Monitor leading indicators such as leads, MQLs, conversion rates, and Cost per Lead (CPL), as well as downstream pipeline, opportunity volume, and revenue influence.

• Design, execute, and analyze experiments across audiences, channels, creative, offers, and funnel stages, translating results into scaled programs and clear recommendations.

• Partner with Global Campaigns, Analytics, Marketing Operations, and external vendors to improve lead quality, strengthen campaign performance, and share actionable insights.





USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $157,000 USD and $228,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $133,000 CAD and $193,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.




Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.



This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work 
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: 

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy 

 Growth and future 
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community 
🤝 Paid volunteer days 
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.



You belong here.

À PROPOS DE LAMOUR 
 Entreprise familiale fondée en 1953, Lamour Inc. s’est forgé une solide réputation comme référence en matière de bas, vêtements de performance, bonneterie et lingerie. Nous faisons partie des 5 plus grands acteurs mondiaux dans les essentiels d’activewear, sommes le leader mondial du vêtement sans couture, et l’un des principaux fabricants de bas au Canada.
 En tant que guichet unique, nous travaillons avec innovation et passion afin d’offrir une qualité exceptionnelle et une grande valeur ajoutée à une clientèle internationale diversifiée. Notre succès repose sur notre expertise en technologies de tissus de performance, notre capacité d’innovation produit, nos investissements en excellence manufacturière, notre rapidité d’exécution, ainsi que la performance de notre chaîne d’approvisionnement, nous permettant de bâtir des partenariats solides, durables et significatifs à travers plusieurs réseaux de distribution.
 À propos du poste 
 US Off-Price est un portefeuille de production rapide et réactif regroupant des programmes sous licence destinés aux détaillants club, de masse et hors-prix. Il gère des volumes élevés à travers de nombreuses usines et pays, selon des échéanciers serrés, avec une charge importante en matière de couleurs, d'emballage et de conformité, et peu de marge d'erreur. 
 Le/la Directeur/Directrice de production prend la responsabilité opérationnelle senior de ce portefeuille : c'est la personne qui résout les problèmes quotidiens afin qu'ils n'aient plus à être escaladés au Directeur, et qui évolue progressivement vers une prise en charge plus complète de l'approvisionnement, de l'établissement des coûts, de la gouvernance et de l'amélioration continue. Ce rôle libère le Directeur pour qu'il se concentre sur la stratégie, les fournisseurs et la croissance, et crée la couverture et la redondance qui manquent actuellement à l'équipe, afin qu'aucune marque ni aucun portefeuille ne dépende d'une seule personne.
 Responsabilités principales 
 À prendre en charge dès le premier jour. 
 Prendre en charge la production de bout en bout. Assumer la pleine responsabilité opérationnelle du portefeuille US Off-Price, du bon de commande à la livraison, piloter le chemin critique, et être la personne qui résout les problèmes et les gère jusqu'à leur résolution plutôt que de les faire remonter.
 Gérer la base d'usines à l'étranger. Assumer la relation quotidienne et la performance des usines au Pakistan, en Inde, en Chine, au Cambodge et ailleurs : capacité, délais de production, exécution, problèmes et escalades.
 Superviser le contrôle qualité, les inspections, les tests et la conformité. Superviser les contrôles qualité et les rapports d'inspection, et s'assurer que les tests, la conformité réglementaire et de marque, ainsi que la documentation d'importateur et de licence, sont tous conformes aux normes.
 Assurer la sortie des expéditions. Veiller à ce que les marchandises soient expédiées à temps, gérer les réservations et la logistique, et lever les obstacles avant qu'ils n'affectent les dates de sortie d'usine et d'expédition.
 Maintenir le système à jour par rapport à la réalité. S'assurer que BlueCherry reflète toujours la situation réelle et actuelle : bons de commande, styles, nomenclatures (BOM), dates de sortie d'usine et d'expédition, et statuts exacts, afin que le WIP soit fiable pour l'ensemble de l'entreprise.
 Assurer la mise à jour hebdomadaire interfonctionnelle. Fournir une mise à jour hebdomadaire claire aux équipes Commerciale, Expédition et Opérations afin que l'ensemble de l'entreprise travaille à partir d'une vision fiable et unique du portefeuille.
 Constituer la couche de couverture. Intervenir et prendre en charge le portefeuille d'un coordinateur en son absence, y compris en assurant la relève sur les plus gros comptes, afin que les absences ne doublent plus la charge de travail du lendemain ni ne retombent sur le Directeur.
 À développer progressivement. 
 Gouvernance et suivi des indicateurs de performance (KPI). Élaborer et gérer les KPI qui pilotent le portefeuille (livraison à temps, retards, délais de production, écarts de coûts, tableaux de bord des usines, statut de conformité), les suivre et en rendre compte pour renforcer la responsabilisation au sein de l'équipe et de la base d'usines.
 Systèmes et outils d'amélioration continue. Développer des tableaux de bord, des outils de suivi et de l'automatisation, y compris l'IA lorsque pertinent, pour réduire le travail manuel, détecter les problèmes tôt, et améliorer continuellement le fonctionnement de l'équipe et du portefeuille.
 Développer l'équipe. Fournir un encadrement quotidien senior à une équipe de coordinateurs relativement junior, en renforçant progressivement leur constance et leur sens des responsabilités.
 Exigences 
 Maîtrise pratique de BlueCherry (CGS), ou d'un système ERP/PLM comparable pour le vêtement, incluant la configuration des bons de commande et des styles, la gestion des dates de sortie d'usine et d'expédition, les nomenclatures (BOM), le suivi des commandes, l'EDI et les rapports. Une expérience avec BlueCherry est fortement privilégiée.
 Expérience senior en production ou en chaîne d'approvisionnement dans le vêtement ou l'importation, avec une réelle prise en charge des usines et des livraisons, idéalement dans un environnement rapide, à haut volume et à grand nombre de références, comme le hors-prix, le club ou la grande distribution.
 Solide compréhension du contrôle qualité, des inspections, des tests et de la conformité (y compris les marques sous licence, l'importateur officiel, le DDP et le FOB), avec la capacité de tenir les usines et les rapports à un haut niveau d'exigence.
 Senior et autonome : quelqu'un à qui le Directeur peut confier la gestion du portefeuille et des problèmes sans avoir à revérifier le travail. La délégation repose sur la confiance ; il s'agit donc d'un poste destiné à une personne compétente et expérimentée, non à un adjoint junior.
 Très soucieux du détail et organisé, à l'aise pour assumer un chemin critique, un suivi documentaire et des dates de livraison strictes sous pression, et pour communiquer clairement le statut aux autres services.
 Excellent communicateur capable de tenir responsables les usines à l'étranger et les partenaires internes, en travaillant à travers différents fuseaux horaires par courriel, vidéoconférence et examen d'échantillons par messagerie.
 Présence sur place à Montréal cinq jours par semaine, étant donné la nature physique et sensible au temps des approbations de production.
 Expérience en gestion d'une grande équipe.
 Atouts recherchés (en lien avec l'évolution du rôle) 
 Expérience en approvisionnement et en établissement des coûts, avec une discipline de type « coût avant prix ».
 Esprit analytique et orienté systèmes : capable de concevoir des KPI et des tableaux de bord d'évaluation des usines, de créer des tableaux de bord et des outils de suivi, et d'utiliser des outils et de l'automatisation, y compris l'IA, pour favoriser l'amélioration continue.
 Connaissance des catégories multi-emballages et à forte composante couleur, comme les sous-vêtements et les articles de base, ainsi que de la coordination d'emballage.
 Une expérience dans le vêtement est un atout, mais le bon profil analytique et orienté production peut provenir de tout environnement de fabrication ou d'opérations soumis à des échéanciers stricts.
 Avantages: 
 Assurance santé et dentaire – On s'occupe de vous!
 Télémédecine – Consultez un médecin à tout moment, directement depuis votre téléphone!
 RVER (Régime volontaire d’épargne-retraite) – On vous aide à épargner pour l'avenir!
 Transport en commun 100 % gratuit – Votre trajet est sur nous!
 Horaires flexibles – Profitez de 12 jours flexibles par année pour travailler de la maison
 Petit-déjeuner gratuit les vendredis – Commencez votre dernière journée de travail de la semaine avec quelque chose de savoureux, offert par nous!
 Vendredis allégés – Terminez à 13h30 durant l'été!
 Une carte-cadeau à votre anniversaire – Bonne fête, de notre part à vous!
 Ambiance terrasse sur le toit l'été – Des pauses avec vue.
 5 à 7 estival – Détendez-vous à l'Esplanade Louvain, un espace extérieur avec jardins et musique, juste à côté.
 Événements d'équipe et célébrations chaque mois – Un grand merci à notre comité social pour maintenir l'ambiance!
 Accès gratuit à la salle d'entraînement sur place – Comprend salle de musculation, yoga, bootcamp et cours de Tabata.
 Stationnement intérieur pour vélos – Roulez en toute tranquillité, peu importe le temps.
 ----
 Family-owned since 1953, Lamour Inc. has earned a reputation for being the best choice in socks, performance apparel, hosiery and lingerie. In fact, we're among the world's top 5 players in activewear basics, the world's leading manufacturer of seamless garments, and one of Canada's leading sock manufacturers. 
 As a one-stop shop, we work innovatively and passionately to deliver exceptional quality and value to a diverse international customer base. It's our focus on performance fabric technology and product innovation, investment in manufacturing excellence, speed-to-market and supply chain execution that enables us to build meaningful, strong and sustainable retail partnerships across multiple trade channels. 
 About the role 
 US Off-Price is a fast, reactive production book of licensed off-price programs shipped to club, mass and off-price retail. It runs high volumes across many factories and countries, on compressed timelines, with a heavy colour, packaging and compliance load and little room for error. The Production Manager takes senior operating ownership of this book, is the person who solves the day-to-day problems so they stop escalating to the Director, and grows into fuller ownership of sourcing, costing, governance and continuous improvement. The role frees the Director to focus on strategy, vendors and growth, and creates the coverage and redundancy the team currently lacks, so that no brand or book depends on a single person.
 Core responsibilities 
 Own from day one. 
 Own production end to end.  Take full operational ownership of the US Off-Price book from PO through delivery, drive the critical path, and be the person who solves problems and manages issues to resolution rather than passing them up.
 Manage the overseas factory base.  Own the day-to-day relationship and performance of factories across Pakistan, India, China, Cambodia and others: capacity, lead times, execution, issues and escalations.
 Oversee QC, inspection, testing and compliance.  Overlook the QCs and inspection reports, and ensure testing, regulatory and brand compliance, and importer and licensing documentation are all up to the mark.
 Drive shipments out.  Ensure goods ship on time, manage bookings and logistics, and clear blockers before they hit ex-factory and ship dates.
 Keep the system reflecting reality.  Ensure BlueCherry is always up to date with the real, current scenario: accurate POs, styles, BOMs, ex-factory and ship dates, and status, so the WIP is reliable for the whole business.
 Own the weekly cross-functional update.  Provide a clear weekly status update to Commercial, Shipping and Operations so the wider business works from one reliable view of the book.
 Be the coverage layer.  Step in and carry a coordinator's book when they are out, including backstopping the largest accounts, so absences no longer double the next day's work or land on the Director.
 Develop over the first 6 to 12 months. 
 Governance and KPI tracking.  Build and own the KPIs that run the book (on-time delivery, past-due, lead time, cost variance, factory scorecards, compliance status), track them, and report against them to drive accountability across the team and the factory base.
 Systems and tools for continuous improvement.  Develop dashboards, trackers and automation, including AI where useful, to cut manual work, surface issues early, and continuously improve how the team and the book run.
 Develop the team.  Give senior day-to-day guidance to a relatively junior coordinator group, raising their consistency and ownership over time.
 Required 
 Hands-on proficiency in BlueCherry (CGS), or a directly comparable apparel ERP/PLM, including PO and style setup, maintaining ex-factory and ship dates, BOMs, order tracking, EDI and reporting. BlueCherry experience is strongly preferred.
 Senior production or supply-chain background in apparel or import, with real ownership of factories and delivery, ideally in a fast, high-volume, high-SKU environment such as off-price, club or mass.
 Strong grasp of QC, inspection, testing and compliance (including licensed brands, importer of record, DDP and FOB), able to hold factories and reports to standard.
 Senior and self-sufficient: someone the Director can trust to own the book and the problems without re-checking the work. Delegation depends on trust, so this is a capable, experienced hire, not a junior assistant.
 Highly detail-oriented and organised, comfortable owning a critical path, a documentation trail and hard delivery dates under pressure, and reporting status clearly to other departments.
 Strong communicator who can hold overseas factories and internal partners to account, working across time zones by email, video and courier sample review.
 Onsite in Montreal five days a week, given the physical, time-sensitive nature of production approvals.
 Experience in managing a large team
 Preferred (aligned to the grow-into scope) 
 Sourcing and costing experience, and cost-before-price discipline.
 Analytical and systems-minded: able to design KPIs and factory scorecards, build dashboards and trackers, and use tools and automation, including AI, to drive continuous improvement.
 Familiarity with multipack and colour-driven categories such as underwear and basics, and with packaging coordination.
 Garment experience is a plus, but the right detailed production mind can come from any deadline-driven manufacturing or operations environment.
 Benefits 
 Health & Dental – Insurance? We got you covered!
 Telemedicine – Access a doctor anytime, right from your phone!
 VRSP (Volunteer Retirement Savings Plan) – We help you save for the future!
 100% free public transit – Your commute is on us!
 Flex hours – Enjoy 12 flex days per year to work from home
 Free breakfast on Fridays – Start your last workday of the week with something tasty on us!
 Early Fridays – Wrap up at 1:30 PM in the summer!
 A gift card on your birthday – happy birthday from us to you!
 Summer rooftop terrace vibes – Work breaks with a view.
 5 à 7 summer hangout – Chill out at Esplanade Louvain, an outdoor space with gardens and music right next door.
 Team events & celebrations every month – Big thanks to our social committee for keeping the fun going!
 On-site free gym access – Includes weight room, yoga, bootcamp, and Tabata classes.
 Indoor bike parking – Ride worry–free, rain or shine.

À propos d'Asteris
 Asteris est un chef de file des technologies d'imagerie vétérinaire. Notre suite logicielle Keystone PACS permet aux cliniques, aux hôpitaux et aux spécialistes vétérinaires de stocker, de consulter, de partager et d'interpréter leurs images diagnostiques, des radiographies aux échographies et aux tomodensitométries, facilement et en toute sécurité, où qu'ils soient. Conçu spécifiquement pour le secteur vétérinaire, Keystone s'intègre aux principaux logiciels de gestion de pratique et soutient des flux de téléconsultation qui aident les vétérinaires à prendre des décisions médicales en toute confiance. Asteris fait partie de Valsoft Corporation, qui acquiert et fait croître des entreprises de logiciels de marchés verticaux.
 Le poste
 À titre de représentant(e) au soutien à la clientèle, vous serez le premier point de contact des cliniques et hôpitaux vétérinaires qui utilisent Keystone. Vous répondrez à leurs questions, résoudrez leurs problèmes de premier niveau et vous assurerez que chaque demande est traitée rapidement, clairement et avec soin, afin que les équipes vétérinaires puissent se concentrer sur leurs patients.
 Vos responsabilités
 Répondre aux demandes des clients par téléphone, courriel et clavardage, et les consigner dans notre système de billets
 Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes courants : accès et connexions, consultation et partage d'images, paramètres des utilisateurs et questions sur l'utilisation du logiciel
 Guider les utilisateurs pas à pas, en des termes simples et adaptés à des personnes non techniques
 Transmettre les problèmes complexes au soutien technique ou à l'équipe produit avec des notes claires et complètes, et assurer le suivi auprès du client jusqu'à la résolution
 Respecter les délais de réponse et de résolution, et prioriser les demandes urgentes qui touchent les soins aux patients
 Créer et mettre à jour des articles de la base de connaissances et des guides pratiques
 Relever les problèmes récurrents et la rétroaction des clients, et les transmettre aux équipes concernées
 —
 About Asteris
 Asteris is a leader in veterinary imaging technology. Our Keystone PACS software suite helps veterinary practices, hospitals, and specialists store, view, share, and report on diagnostic images, from radiographs to ultrasound and CT, easily and securely from anywhere. Built specifically for the veterinary industry, Keystone integrates with leading practice management systems and powers teleconsultation workflows that help veterinarians make confident medical decisions. Asteris is part of Valsoft Corporation, which acquires and grows vertical market software companies.
 The Role
 As a Customer Support Representative, you'll be the first point of contact for veterinary practices and hospitals using Keystone. You'll answer their questions, solve first-level issues, and make sure every request is handled quickly, clearly and with care, so veterinary teams can stay focused on their patients.
 What You'll Do
 Respond to client requests by phone, email and chat, and log them in our ticketing system
 Troubleshoot and resolve common issues: access and connectivity, viewing and sharing images, user settings, and how-to questions
 Walk users through solutions step by step, in plain language suited to non-technical users
 Escalate complex issues to Technical Support or Product with clear, complete notes, and follow up with the client until they're resolved
 Meet response and resolution targets, and prioritize urgent requests that affect patient care
 Create and update knowledge base articles and how-to guides
 Spot recurring issues and client feedback, and share them with the right teams
 Ce que vous apportez
 Deux ans ou plus d'expérience en soutien à la clientèle ou en soutien technique, idéalement dans un environnement logiciel ou SaaS
 Expérience avec un système de billets ou de centre d'assistance (p. ex. Zendesk, Freshdesk, Jira Service Management)
 Excellentes aptitudes en communication, à l'oral comme à l'écrit, et beaucoup de patience avec des utilisateurs non techniques
 Esprit de résolution de problèmes et souci du détail dans la documentation des dossiers
 Capacité à gérer un volume élevé de demandes et à établir les priorités

 Town Web · HeyGov

 The Quick Version 
 Have you ever seen a company create their own National Holiday as part of its marketing efforts? 
 We did!
 Speaking of silly stuff, we even wrote and produced our own comedic commercial about the real pains that our customers have, and it helped make one of our tools the fastest growing AI tool in the industry! 
 Ultimately we want our marketing to be funny, human, and memorable, because honestly a lot of the stuff out there in the government industry (which is where we compete) is boring. 
 Now we're looking for someone exceptionally creative to lead our marketing department — a person with the freedom to take big creative swings and the resources to execute their own.
 Our brands — Town Web, HeyGov, and ClerkMinutes — form a suite of tools built specifically for municipal clerks, and each one is crafted to be exceptional at its job. If you're a highly effective, exceptional marketing professional, we'd love for you to apply. Below are more details about who we are and what we're trying to achieve.
 Here's a video to tell you more about this role !
 The details 
 Who we are
 We're a small, bootstrapped company approaching $3M in ARR, competing against large, private-equity-owned firms with far deeper pockets. That's why our marketing has to be exceptional on two fronts at once: creative work that is unique and memorable, and follow-through to match it — multi-channel campaigns, disciplined measurement, and sophisticated execution that turns attention into pipeline.
 Our customers are municipal clerks at cities, counties, and municipalities of all sizes. They are busy, under-resourced, deeply practical, and they talk to each other (which as you can guess is why we are emphasising the need to have exceptional marketing!)
 We build focused products for the clerk specifically, designed to work together as a suite. ClerkMinutes became one of the most widely adopted tools in its category largely on the strength of marketing that looked like nothing else in this space, and your job is to push that further across the whole portfolio. We run on EOS, and the marketing department's cadence — L10s, quarterly Rocks, scorecards — will be yours to run.
 What you'll own
 Strategy and positioning across the portfolio, and the department's EOS operating cadence
 Demand and revenue — building a qualified pipeline for Sales through targeted campaigns and similar initiatives. This is how success is measured. 
 Full-channel execution — conferences, webinars, direct mail, PR, and outbound alongside digital and paid. Clerks trust people who show up in person, so you will too.
 Lifecycle marketing — from first touch through trial to customer, along with the tech, tracking, and attribution behind it
 The quality bar — you're the final day-to-day reviewer on copy, design, campaigns, and launches
 Go-to-market with Product and Sales — new product launches and targeted campaigns that get us early beta testers, help build awareness for product pilots, and than formal product releases.
 Who does well here
 Isn’t it clear we’re looking for somebody extremely creative and ambitious!? 😛Are you “THE ONE?” 
 We’re looking for a creative strategist and an enthusiastic builder who can lead the team from the front line. Think of a special-forces team leader: they plan the mission, and when it's time to move, they're also the first one through the door. That's the posture this role needs — you set the strategy, and then you're in the weeds executing it right alongside the team.
 And there is a team. You'll work directly with our copywriters, internal product managers, the sales team, and the people who handle data connection and attribution through Salesforce and our other marketing tools. You'll have a team around you, but want to be clear: we’re not looking for a “manager of managers”.
 AI tools like Claude or Codex are part of your daily workflow, and you rely on them to get competent quickly in unfamiliar territory, whether that's GEO, GA4, or something we haven't thought of yet. You also know how to work with a highly creative founder: turning a lot of ideas into focused priorities, pushing back when something won't work, and making sure the good ones actually ship.
 This role suits someone who's comfortable working without a finished playbook, and who would rather be in the work than above it.
 What we need to see
 Exceptional Enthusiasm
 Extremely Creative Energy
 You've led a marketing function and been accountable for its results
 You've made a traditional or crowded category stand out with ideas of your own
 AI is central to how you work, and you're comfortable enough with code to build or fix small things yourself
 Real paid acquisition experience across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and Bing, and you can run SEO and GEO by directing AI tools well
 Hands-on experience with direct mail, paid ads, conferences, PR, or other high-attention channels, and you're happy traveling to meet clerks and work conferences alongside Sales
 B2B SaaS background, and you've managed employees, contractors, and agencies

À propos de GSK 
 Chez GSK, nous œuvrons à prévenir et à traiter les maladies grâce à la science, à la technologie et aux talents. 
 Notre réseau de sites de production de médicaments et de vaccins joue un rôle essentiel dans la mise à disposition de produits de haute qualité pour répondre aux besoins des patients partout dans le monde. Nous investissons dans les technologies de pointe et dans l’amélioration continue de nos procédés afin de répondre aux défis liés à la fabrication de produits toujours plus complexes. 
 À propos du poste 
 Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) Expert(e) Technologie et procédés (SME Technology) pour joindre l’équipe LMSAT à Ste-foy, Québec. 
 Le poste d’Expert Technologie et procédés – LMSAT est un rôle d’expertise technique visant à assurer la maîtrise, l’optimisation et le soutien des technologies, équipements, systèmes et procédés utilisés dans les activités de fabrication. 
 La personne titulaire du poste agit à titre de référence technique pour les activités liées aux procédés, contribue à la résolution de problèmes complexes et soutient les initiatives d’optimisation, de transfert technologique et d’amélioration des procédés, en collaboration avec les équipes de production, d’ingénierie, de qualité et les partenaires concernés. 
 Vos responsabilités 
 Expertise technique 
 Agir comme expert(e) de référence pour les technologies, équipements et systèmes liés aux procédés de fabrication du site. 
 Fournir une expertise technique pour l’exploitation, la validation, le dépannage et l’optimisation de ces systèmes. 
 Apporter un soutien technique aux équipes opérationnelles et aux différentes parties prenantes du site. 
 Optimisation des procédés 
 Identifier et mettre en œuvre des opportunités d’optimisation en cohérence avec le Technical Lifecycle Plan (TLCP). 
 Contribuer à l’amélioration de l’efficacité, de la performance, de l’évolutivité et de la sécurité des procédés. 
 Collaborer avec des équipes multidisciplinaires afin de faire progresser les initiatives d’amélioration continue. 
 Gestion des changements 
 Fournir une expertise technique dans l’évaluation de l’impact des modifications proposées aux procédés de fabrication. 
 Évaluer les impacts potentiels des changements sur la qualité, la sécurité et la performance des procédés. 
 Investigations et résolution de problèmes 
 Apporter une expertise technique lors des investigations liées aux déviations. 
 Participer aux analyses de causes racines et contribuer à l’identification de solutions robustes et durables. 
 Transfert technologique 
 Soutenir les activités de transfert technologique, notamment lors de l’introduction de nouveaux procédés, équipements ou technologies. 
 Collaborer avec les équipes concernées afin d’assurer une intégration efficace des nouvelles technologies. 
 Développement de l’expertise 
 Se tenir informé(e) des avancées technologiques et des meilleures pratiques de l’industrie. 
 Partager ses connaissances et contribuer au développement des capacités techniques au sein de l’organisation. 
 Agir comme mentor ou personne-ressource auprès des membres de l’équipe lorsque requis. 
 Collaboration et communication 
 Collaborer avec les responsables LMSAT globaux, les SME technologiques d’autres sites et les équipes locales. 
 Participer à des projets et initiatives à l’échelle de GSK. 
 Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d’ingénierie, des opérations, de la qualité et autres fonctions pertinentes. 
 Communiquer efficacement des informations techniques complexes à différents niveaux de l’organisation. 
 Pourquoi vous? 
 Nous recherchons une personne techniquement solide, autonome et proactive, capable d’agir comme référence dans son domaine et d’influencer efficacement différents partenaires dans un environnement matriciel. 
 Qualifications requises 
 Diplôme universitaire dans une discipline scientifique, technique ou d’ingénierie. 
 Minimum de 5 années d’expérience professionnelle pertinente dans un domaine technique lié aux activités de fabrication. 
 Expérience dans un ou plusieurs domaines liés aux procédés de fabrication, notamment la formulation, le remplissage ou d’autres étapes du procédé. 
 Expérience de travail avec des équipes multidisciplinaires. 
 Expérience en gestion des risques et/ou gestion de projets. 
 Connaissance des exigences réglementaires applicables à son domaine d’expertise. 
 Solides compétences en rédaction technique et en communication. 
 Capacité à influencer et à collaborer avec des parties prenantes à différents niveaux de l’organisation et dans différentes fonctions. 
 Expérience dans la conduite ou la direction d’activités d’amélioration dans un environnement matriciel. 
 Excellente capacité à planifier, organiser et gérer plusieurs priorités afin de respecter les échéanciers. 
 Capacité à travailler avec précision dans un environnement dynamique et sous pression. 
 Anglais avancé, à l’oral et à l’écrit. 
 Ce qui constitue un atout 
 Expérience dans un environnement de fabrication pharmaceutique ou biopharmaceutique. 
 Expérience avec les procédés de formulation ou de remplissage. 
 Expérience en transfert technologique. 
 Expérience en amélioration continue et optimisation des procédés. 
 Expérience en investigation et analyse de causes racines. 
 Connaissance des principes de gestion du cycle de vie des technologies et des procédés. 
 Mode de travail 
 Ce poste est offert en mode hybride, conformément à la politique RH interne en matière de télétravail. Vous serez basé(e) à Sainte-Foy, Québec, et devrez assurer une présence régulière sur le site et sur le terrain, notamment pour collaborer avec les équipes de production, soutenir les activités techniques et participer aux essais, validations et autres activités nécessitant une présence en production. 
 À quoi ressemble la réussite dans ce rôle? 
 Dans ce rôle, votre contribution se traduira notamment par : 
 Des solutions techniques robustes et une documentation technique claire, précise et utilisable. 
 Une réduction des problèmes liés aux procédés et une résolution plus rapide des enjeux techniques. 
 Des transferts de produits, de procédés et de technologies réalisés de façon fluide, dans le respect des exigences de qualité et des échéanciers. 
 Une collaboration efficace entre les équipes de production, d’ingénierie, de qualité, LMSAT et les partenaires externes. 
 Une contribution concrète à l’optimisation et à la performance des procédés de fabrication. 
 Ce que nous offrons 
 Vous rejoindrez une équipe qui valorise l’expertise technique, la collaboration et l’amélioration continue. 
 Ce rôle vous permettra de travailler sur des enjeux techniques concrets, de collaborer avec des experts locaux et internationaux et de contribuer à des projets qui ont un impact direct sur nos procédés de fabrication. 
 Vous aurez également l’occasion de développer votre expertise et votre réseau au sein d’une organisation qui place la science, la technologie et l’innovation au cœur de sa mission. 
 Prêt(e) à faire avancer les choses? 
 Nous aimerions en savoir plus sur vous. 
 Soumettez votre CV ainsi qu’une courte présentation expliquant comment votre expérience correspond aux responsabilités de ce poste. 
 Si vous avez besoin de mesures d’adaptation raisonnables dans le cadre du processus de recrutement, veuillez nous en informer au moment de votre candidature. Nous sommes engagés à favoriser l’inclusion et à soutenir tous les candidats tout au long du processus de recrutement. 
 Compétences 
CMC Strategy, Data-Driven Decision Making, Data Integrity, Debate Moderation, Digital Fluency, GxP Regulations, Lean Management, Problem Solving, Process Optimization, Project Leadership, Risk Awareness, Scientific Writing, Technology Transfer  
 Pourquoi GSK?
Allier science, technologie et talent pour vaincre ensemble la maladie. 
 GSK est une entreprise biopharmaceutique mondiale dont la mission est de réunir la science, la technologie et le talent pour prendre ensemble de l'avance sur les maladies. Nous visons à avoir un impact positif sur la santé de 2,5 milliards de personnes d'ici la fin de la décennie, en tant qu'entreprise prospère et en croissance où les gens peuvent s'épanouir. Nous prenons de l'avance sur les maladies en les prévenant et en les traitant grâce à l'innovation dans les médicaments spécialisés et les vaccins. Nous nous concentrons sur quatre domaines thérapeutiques : les maladies respiratoires, l'immunologie et l'inflammation; l'oncologie; le VIH; les maladies infectieuses – pour avoir un impact à grande échelle sur la santé.
 Les gens et les patients partout dans le monde comptent sur les médicaments et les vaccins que nous produisons; c'est pourquoi nous nous engageons à créer un environnement où nos employés peuvent s'épanouir et se concentrer sur ce qui compte le plus. Notre culture, qui repose sur l'ambition pour les patients, la responsabilité de la portée et le fait de faire ce qui est juste, constitue la base de la manière dont nous tenons nos engagements ensemble pour les patients, les actionnaires et nos employés.
 GSK est un employeur offrant l'égalité des chances. GSK s'engage à accueillir les personnes handicapées. Si vous avez besoin d'un aménagement à n'importe quelle étape du processus de candidature ou si vous souhaitez plus d'informations sur nos politiques d'aménagement, veuillez nous contacter à canada-recruitment@gsk.com . Veuillez ne pas envoyer de CV à cette adresse e-mail et postuler plutôt via le processus de candidature en ligne de cette annonce.
 Avis important destiné aux services/agences de placement

Float is Canada’s intelligent financial operating system, combining modern financial services and software to help businesses spend, save, and grow. AI USE IN OUR HIRING PROCESS

We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of our hiring process. This may include AI-assisted scheduling and candidate communications, and AI-generated interview notes, guides or summaries to help our team focus on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Float is looking for a Product Operations Manager to work alongside the team building our corporate card and spend management products. You'll be the person who decides — with data — what's worth building next, and then proves whether it worked.



This is a hands-on analytical seat with real influence over the roadmap. You'll size opportunities, build the business case for where the team should invest, and own the reporting that tells product and go-to-market teams what's actually happening. The work runs from writing your own queries through to putting a recommendation in front of leadership. Recent projects in this seat have included protecting card spend through a major payments migration and rebuilding how customer feedback gets synthesized into prioritization.



There's a second half to the job that matters just as much: making the team faster. We want someone who looks at how product decisions get researched and made, finds the parts that are slower than they need to be, and builds the automation to fix them.




WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Size and build the business case for roadmap initiatives, so the team can decide what to invest in with real numbers behind it.

 - Own the reporting and dashboards for the product area — measuring what shipped, and making the results useful to both product and go-to-market teams.

 - Turn customer and field feedback into a prioritization signal the team acts on, rather than a document nobody reads.

 - Lead the analysis behind major forward-looking investment decisions, working across teams to build and present the proposal.

 - Build AI-assisted workflows that make research, synthesis, and reporting materially faster — and pick the ones worth building based on impact.

 - Partner with data engineering to get the data you need, and write your own SQL for everything else.

 - Surface risks and trade-offs early, with options attached.




ABOUT YOU


HERE'S WHAT SETS YOU UP FOR SUCCESS AT FLOAT:

 - You Put Customers First, Always. You care deeply about delivering meaningful value. Whether you're building internal systems or customer-facing features, you're always thinking about how to make life better for our users.

 - You Act Like an Owner. You take responsibility for outcomes, step up to challenges, and seek solutions proactively—doing what's best for the business, not just your role.

 - You Think Big and Move Fast. You're energized by building from 0 to 1. You're not afraid to challenge the status quo, experiment quickly, and learn as you go.

 - You Constantly Learn and Grow. You're hungry to improve your craft and open to feedback. You bring a growth mindset to everything you do.

 - Experience building a business case that changed what an organization decided to invest in.

ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.


ABOUT THE HEALTHCARE TEAM

 - Our healthcare agents already reach over 50% of U.S. families. We partner with leading health plans, providers, and healthcare platforms to deliver AI agents that handle some of the most sensitive and high stakes conversations in any industry. From helping members understand their benefits to resolving billing questions with empathy, our healthcare agents are transforming how patients and policyholders interact with the healthcare system.

 - Our healthcare customers include major health insurance networks, nonprofit providers, multi-site primary and urgent care practices, healthcare diagnostics companies, and healthcare financial platforms.

 - Join us to transform the patient experience across the healthcare system—and help build technology that makes care more accessible, more human and more affordable for everyone.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Prospecting & lead generation: Identify and target potential customers through research, networking, and cold calling. Build new relationships with our enterprise customers and prospects to drive revenue, pipeline, and deployment capacity.

 - Manage relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders with our largest customers. Serve as their primary point of contact and exceed their expectations.

 - Negotiating & closing complex deal cycles: Lead negotiations with existing and prospective customers, addressing objections and closing deals. Navigate contracts and agreements quickly and effectively, working closely with legal and finance stakeholders.

 - Sales strategy & planning: Develop and execute sales strategies to meet or exceed sales targets. Craft tailored sales presentations and proposals that meet our enterprise customers needs. Collaborate with our marketing team to implement effective sales campaigns and presentations.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with our broader GTM team, as well as our product, technical and operations orgs to deliver our industry-leading product.

 - Operate as an AI-native seller: Leverage AI tools across the full sales cycle- account research, personalized outreach, call summarization, pipeline forecasting, and deal execution- to automate low-value tasks and reinvest that time into high-value customer relationships, while continuously adopting and experimenting with new tools to work faster and smarter than traditional methods allow.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 6-8 years of experience in an enterprise customer-facing sales role, identifying and closing large accounts.

 - Enterprise experience: Experience managing a $1M+ quota and running end-to-end complex 6- and 7-figure ACV deals.

 - Strong communication skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication abilities.

 - Analytical mindset: Ability to analyze market trends, identify opportunities, and make data-driven decisions.

 - Prospecting & lead generation: Proven track record of identifying and targeting potential enterprise clients through research, networking, and cold calling.


EVEN BETTER...

 - Industry knowledge: Familiarity with the AI landscape, key players, and emerging trends.


OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 - Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 - Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 - Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability benefits

 - Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 - Parental leave

 - Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

 - Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

 - Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.


BE YOU, WITH US

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. New Flyer is North America's heavy-duty transit bus leader and offers the most advanced product line under the Xcelsior® and Xcelsior CHARGE® brands. It also offers infrastructure development through NFI Infrastructure Solutions™, a service dedicated to providing safe, sustainable, and reliable charging and mobility solutions. Further information is available at www.newflyer.com 
 POSITION SUMMARY 
 Working under the direction of the Sr. Technical Editor (Data Management), you will research and analyze multiple data sources such as Bills of Material (BOMs), engineering drawings, and vendor information in order to assemble build-specific data packages (parts lists and illustration mark-ups) for use in the parts manual production process. You will also perform parts manual update research and editing tasks as determined by the Sr. Technical Editor or Publications Coordinator when required.
 WHAT YOU WILL DO 
 Create manual section research packages by extracting data from all available sources such as engineering BOMs, product photos, supplier documents, engineering specs, engineering drawings, and use to identify changes or new info to existing bus parts data.
 Effectively organize the assigned research information packages (both hard copy and electronic versions) in order of priority and project strategy so they can be completed and handed over to the graphics team for illustrating within the deadlines given.
 Complete all research work tasks as assigned by Technical Editors and following established work procedures.
 Contact any engineering staff or Part Supplier to clarify and verify the accuracy of their data or to source new data if required. This is very important which requires proper communication and investigative skills in order to obtain the required information within the timeframe available for each project. Maintaining a good working relationship with each supplier.
 Maintain proper records of part supplier (vendor) data requests and perform follow-up actions to ensure that data requested is correct and obtained when required.
 Perform all research duties according to established procedures and guidelines and to proactively communicate with Technical Editors at any time when you are not certain.
 Perform editing tasks as determined by the Sr.Tech Editor or Publications Coordinator when required to supplement any shortfalls of editing capacity. Those tasks can include; Administrative, editing, statistics/metrics reports, mentoring and supplying alternative solution suggestions.
 Perform manual update recording and manual bulletin creation when required.
 Complete tasks within specified time schedule deadlines and perform quality control checks of all work before handing in.
 Assign new New Flyer part numbers to new OEM supplier parts.
 Properly maintain and archive source documentation in both electronic and hard copy formats.
 Collect and communicate to the Technical Editor all data inaccuracies identified during the project so they are promptly recorded into the update system.
 Perform efficiently and effectively in a team environment.
 Consult with Technical Editors for clarification and information.
 Upgrade skills on new or updated software.
 Certification/diploma from recognized technical school as a Mechanical Engineering Technologist or equivalent workplace experience.
 3-5 years experience in interpreting Manufacturing BOMs and engineering drawings into service parts lists.
 Heavy equipment/automotive parts manufacturing background.
 Experience in sourcing vendor data.
 Experience with Enginering Data Management systems such as TeamCenter.
 Capable of working under tight deadlines.
 Min. 2 years expierence working in the technical publishing industry as a data research technician.
 Excellent investigative and communication skills in an engineering environment.
 Effective customer service skills.
 Strong working knowledge in MS Office applications, Windows OS and network. Experience in Oracle database ERP systems and TeamCenter would be an asset.  
 Excellent mechanical aptitude.

Job Description Summary 
We are looking for a Lead Project Manager to lead the execution of complex substation projects within GE Vernova’s Grid Systems Integration business. In this role, you will coordinate multiple sub-projects and workstreams, ensuring alignment across engineering, procurement, manufacturing, construction, commissioning, and customer-facing activities.
You will be responsible for driving project execution from planning through delivery, while consolidating progress, risks, and priorities into a clear overall project view. The role also requires strong reporting and communication with leadership, as well as close collaboration with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure project objectives are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in line with quality and contractual requirements. 
 Job Description 
 Role Summary/Purpose 
 The Lead Project Manager is responsible for leading the execution of large, complex substation projects within GE Vernova’s Grid Systems Integration (GSI) business, where multiple interdependent sub-projects must be coordinated into one integrated delivery plan. This role consolidates and supports activities across engineering, procurement, manufacturing, construction, commissioning, and customer interface workstreams to ensure alignment on scope, schedule, cost, quality, and contract commitments.
 In addition to managing the full range of project management activities, the Lead Project Manager serves as a critical link between project execution teams and leadership, providing structured governance, reliable reporting, risk visibility, and timely escalation of issues affecting delivery. The role requires strong cross-functional coordination, deep understanding of substation project execution, and the ability to translate detailed project performance into clear insights and decision support for internal leadership and external stakeholders.
 Essential Responsibilities 
 Perform Project scope review and compare with the GEV quote upon transfer of the project file from the Commercial group to Project management.
 Lead the project kick-off meeting with all internal contributors and assign roles and responsibilities.
 Lead the customer kick-off meeting to communicate the nature of the work that will be done and clarify any issues in the order.
 Lead the overall execution of complex substation projects, ensuring delivery in line with contractual scope, schedule, budget, quality, and safety requirements.
 Consolidate and coordinate activities across multiple sub-projects and workstreams, creating an integrated project view and ensuring alignment of priorities, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables.
 Drive project planning and execution across engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, construction, commissioning, and handover activities.
 Establish and maintain effective project governance, including project reviews, action tracking, decision logs, escalation management, and leadership reporting.
 Monitor project performance against key metrics and proactively identify, assess, and mitigate risks, issues, delays, and cost impacts that could affect successful delivery.
 Support sub-project leaders and functional teams in resolving cross-functional challenges, removing execution barriers, and maintaining focus on critical path activities.
 Manage customer communication and stakeholder coordination to ensure transparency, alignment, and timely resolution of technical, commercial, and execution-related matters.
 Ensure compliance with contract requirements, internal processes, quality standards, and applicable regulatory and safety expectations throughout the project lifecycle.
 Lead change management activities, including evaluation of scope changes, schedule impacts, cost implications, and associated approvals or customer notifications.
 Prepare and deliver accurate, timely project status updates, forecasts, and executive summaries to leadership, highlighting performance, risks, decisions required, and recovery actions where needed.
 Drive a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across the project team and interfacing functions.
 Support project closing activities, including final deliverables, lessons learned, financial closure, and transition to warranty or service phases where applicable.
 Required Qualifications / Experience 
 Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, operations, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, Lean, Six Sigma) preferred.
 Minimum 3 years of project management experience relevant to the role, in substations, grid infrastructure, energy, or other large and complex industrial projects along with managing project schedule, budget, quality, and safety deliverables end-to-end.
 Minimum 3 years of direct site execution experience on substation, grid infrastructure, or large-scale industrial/construction projects
 Eligibility Requirements 
 Must be a US Person (US Citizen or Green Card holder) — no visa sponsorship available due to project/export control requirements.
 Must be willing and able to travel 15% on average, up to 20% at peak, including week-long site visits approximately every 6 weeks.
 Must be able to work from a home office/remote setup or one of the approved locations (Houston, Chicago, Atlanta, or La Prairie, Canada) — no relocation assistance provided.
 Desired Skills & Experience 
 Demonstrated experience managing complex projects with multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and interdependencies.
 Experience working in cross-functional and international project environments.
 Strong background in project management methodologies, tools, and governance frameworks.
 Experience working with global or regional stakeholders, ideally in a matrixed environment.
 Strong leadership and coordination skills in complex, multi-workstream project environments.
 Ability to manage competing priorities and drive execution with a structured, proactive approach.
 Strong communication, coordination, and organizational skills.
 Clear communicator with the ability to engage effectively with teams, customers, and leadership. Strong problem-solving, risk awareness, and decision-making skills.
 Experience in substation or grid project environments is a strong advantage.
 Fluent in English is required; French is a plus.
 Core Competencies 
 Strategic Thinking: Ability to design scalable frameworks and anticipate operational needs.
 Change Leadership: Skilled at driving adoption, influencing stakeholders, and managing organizational change.
 Collaboration & Communication: Strong interpersonal skills to align diverse teams and communicate complex concepts clearly.
 Execution Excellence: Focused on quality, consistency, and continuous improvement.
 Problem‑Solving: Adept at diagnosing root causes, navigating ambiguity, and proposing practical solutions.
 Data‑Driven Decision Making: Uses metrics, trends, and insights to guide priorities and measure impact.
